nodes.title: LC Split Sigma Scheduler
widgets_values:
- Designed to mimic two Ksamplers chained, but for sampler custom advanced nodes
- keeps the Sampler path open to plug in nodes like **detail daemon** and **🤡 ClownSampler**
- ⚠️ requires a disable noise plugged into the second pass noise slot.
- You have the option of using two models (defaults to top slot if not used). great for **controlnet cleanup** or when you want a seperate detailer

**LC Prompt to Conditioning**
- compact version of a clip text encode node

**LC Prompt to Conditioning + Zero**
- same as above, but with built in zero out

nodes.title: Pipe Options
widgets_values:
## Designed for ease of use with my workflows
- works with **Get/Set** nodes
- Plugs into **Basic Pipe** sockets on impact nodes

# ComfyUI LC123 Nodes

Custom nodes for [ComfyUI](https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI) by [lonecatone23](https://github.com/lonecatone23).

- **Repo:** [https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC123_nodes](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC123_nodes)
- **Support:** [Buy me a ☕](https://ko-fi.com/lonecatone)

> Small tools that remove friction — less wire mess, fewer clicks, clearer workflows.

For **Anima regional attention**, also install [Sen-sou Anima Regional Conditioning](https://github.com/Sen-sou/Comfyui-Anima-Regional-Conditioning).

---

## 🖼️ Image & size

| Node | What it does |
|------|----------------|
| **📐 Aspect Ratio Simplifier** | Pick a size from an image, a mask, or a preset. Resize image and mask together. Crop, stretch, pad, or match total pixels. Also outputs an empty latent. |
| **📐 Aspect Ratio Simplifier (pipe)** | Same controls, plus a **pipe** output on top for Get/Set routing. |
| **LC Aspect Ratio Pipe** | Unpacks an aspect-ratio pipe back into image, mask, width, height, latent, batch. |
| **LC Get Image 📐** | Reads an image and shows **megapixels**, **width**, **height**, and **batch**. Useful for quick checks. |
| **LC Image Compare 🔎** | Side-by-side batch compare with one slider for both images (A1↔B1, A2↔B2, …). Fixed layout so previews don’t jump. |
| **LC Last Image Holder** | Holds the last generated image so you can compare before/after. Survives a disconnected input; clear button empties it without re-running the graph. |
| **LC Dynamic Overlay** | Lay image B over image A. A sets the resolution; B is scaled to fit. After one run, drag the circular opacity knob — no re-generate needed to preview the blend. |

---

## 🎨 Regional canvas

| Node | What it does |
|------|----------------|
| **Anima Regional Inline Canvas** | Paint red / green / blue regions on the node. Builds separate GLOBAL / RED / GREEN / BLUE conditioning and masks for Sen-sou Anima. Pauses until you hit Apply. |
| **Krea2 Regional Inline Canvas** | Same paint UI aimed at Krea2 CLIP regional work. **Beta — still improving.** |

---

## 🔧 Sampling helpers

| Node | What it does |
|------|----------------|
| **LC Sampler Configure** | One place for dual-pass settings: total steps, 1st/2nd CFG, denoise, step swap, sampler, scheduler. |
| **LC Sampler Configure (pipe)** | Same widgets, plus a **pipe** on top for Get/Set. |
| **LC Sampler Configure Pipe** | Unpacks a sampler pipe into the individual sockets. |
| **LC Split Sigma Scheduler** | Builds high/low sigma schedules for a two-pass custom sampler chain. Optional second model (falls back to the first). |
| **LC VRAM Cache Clear** | Pass-through node that clears GPU / model cache when it runs. Drop it after a heavy pass before the next stage. |
| **LC Stop 🛑** | mxStop-style breakpoint with an enable switch. Stops the queue at this point; continue from the play control / queue. Bypass = pass data through without stopping. |

---

## 🧵 Pipes

| Node | What it does |
|------|----------------|
| **LC Pipe In** | Pack models, clips, VAEs, size, latent, prompts, seed, steps, CFGs, sampler… into one **LC_PIPE** wire. |
| **LC Pipe Out** | Unpack that pipe into individual sockets (same order top → bottom). |
| **LC Pipe Edit** | Merge overrides into an existing pipe without rebuilding everything. |

Works with **KJ Set/Get** (and any type-agnostic Get/Set). Prefer a direct In → Out link when you need rock-solid caching.

---

## ✍️ Prompts & conditioning

| Node | What it does |
|------|----------------|
| **Positive** | Green prompt box. Outputs a string. |
| **Negative** | Red prompt box. Outputs a string. |
| **Prompt to Conditioning** | CLIP-encode a string (socket only — no text box on the node). |
| **LC Prompt to Conditioning + Zero** | Same encode, plus a second **zero out** socket (like ConditioningZeroOut). |

---

## 📁 Save paths

| Node | What it does |
|------|----------------|
| **LC Easy Folder 📂** | Builds a single `filename_prefix` for the native Save Image node (`Folder\prefix_suffix_timestamp`). Creates the folder if needed. |
| **LC Advanced Folder 📂** | Split **filename** + **path** for Image Saver Simple. Optional prefix-in-path. |
| **📝 LC Save Text** | Write a text string to a file (logs, captions, notes). |

---

## 🔀 Switches, logic & control

| Node | What it does |
|------|----------------|
| **LC AnySwitch** | Pick the first connected input among many. Locks type from the first wire. Blocks Use Everywhere auto-wiring. 2–20 inputs. Avoids circular-reference headaches common with some other any-switches. |
| **LC Combo Selector** | Dropdown that mirrors another node’s combo options (scheduler, sampler, etc.) when wired into a converted combo input. |
| **LC Boolean** | Turns a boolean, int, or float into a clean true/false. Shows the result on the node face. |
| **LC Invert Boolean** | Same coercion, then flips the result. Shows true/false on the face. |
| **LC Bypasser** | Bypass one or more nodes from one place. Optional BOOLEAN enable sockets; 🔒 when driven remotely. |
| **LC Groups Bypasser** | Same idea for **groups** — discovers groups on the graph and toggles them. |
| **LC Slider** | Slider on the node face. Min / max / step / decimals in settings. INT or FLOAT out. Works with Nodes 2.0. |

---

nodes.title: Notes:
widgets_values:
## Instructions

# 🛑🚫✋ I HIGHLY suggest that you fix the seed, run the pic, then don’t mess with anything before this so it doesn’t reprocess.

### Node order (follow the chain top → bottom)

**Smart Denoise (LCImageDenoise)**  
- Removes noise while trying to keep detail  
- Sigma: higher = smoother, lower = more detail  
- Threshold: how aggressive the denoise is  
- Radius Multiplier: higher for noisy images, lower for clean ones  
💡 Start gentle. Only raise values if the image is actually noisy.

**Color Match (LCColorMatch)**  
- Matches colors to a reference image (usually Image 2)  
- Method: “adain” is the most common and stable  
- Strength: 0–1  

**Bloom (LCBloom)**  
- Soft glow on bright areas (camera light bloom)  
- Intensity, threshold, and size controls  
💡 A little makes it dreamy. A lot makes it foggy.

**Vignette (LCVignette)**  
- Darkens (or lightens) the edges  
- Amount, softness, and roundness  
💡 Soft vignette looks more natural than hard black borders.

**Image RGB (LCImageRGB)**  
- Simple red / green / blue channel gain  

**Lift / Gamma / Gain (LCLiftGammaGain)**  
- Classic three-way color corrector  
- Lift = shadows  
- Gamma = midtones  
- Gain = highlights  
💡 This is where most “film look” color work happens.

**Auto White Balance (LCAutoWhiteBalance)**  
- Tries to neutralize overall color cast  
- Method: “Shades of Gray” is usually safest  
💡 Effect is subtle — compare before/after.

**Vibrance (LCVibrance)**  
- Boosts muted colors without destroying already-saturated areas  
- Kinder to skin than normal saturation  
- Vibrance + Saturation + Strength  
💡 Prefer this over regular saturation for portraits.

**Chromatic Aberration (LCChromaticAberration)**  
- Shifts RGB channels for a 3-D / vintage lens look  
- Separate horizontal/vertical amounts for R, G, B  
💡 A little goes a long way. Try small opposite values (R +2, G –1, B –3).

**Clarity (LCClarity)**  
- Adaptive mid-tone contrast / micro-contrast  
- Radius, strength, blend mode, shadow/highlight controls  
💡 Super important node. Adds “pop” without the cardboard cut-out look.

**Image Adjust (LCImageAdjust)**  
- Brightness, Contrast, Saturation, Sharpness, Blur  
- Brightness center = 0  
- Contrast & Saturation center = 1  

**Lens FX (LCLensFX)**  
- General lens distortion and optical effects  
💡 Pair with the next node for more realistic camera simulation.

**Lens Profile (LCLensProfile)**  
- Applies real lens characteristics (e.g. Canon 50mm f/1.8)  
- Optional aberrations  
💡 Adds subtle optical imperfections that make AI images feel more photographic.

**Film Stock B&W (LCFilmStockBW)**  
- Converts to black & white using real film responses  
- 50+ stocks (Ilford HP5+, Kodak Tri-X, Fuji Acros, etc.)  
- Strength + optional filter  
💡 Leave this off if you want to keep color.

**Film Stock Color (LCFilmStockColor)**  
- Applies classic color film response (Ektachrome, Portra, etc.)  
- Strength is the main control  
💡 0.6–0.9 often looks more natural than full strength.

**Film Grain (LCFilmGrain)**  
- Realistic film grain with lots of control  
- Power, scale, shadows/highlights, seed  
💡 Fixed seed keeps the grain consistent. Slightly more grain in shadows usually looks better.

**Desaturate (LCImageDesaturate)**  
- Partial or full desaturation  
- Several methods (luminance Rec.709 is common)  
💡 Useful right before a LUT if you want a muted base.

**Apply LUT (LCApplyLUT)**  
- Applies a 3D LUT (.cube file)  
- Strength 0–1  
- Log option for certain LUTs  
💡 Free LUTs at freshluts.com. Strength 0.3–0.7 is often nicer than 1.0. Put .cube files in the luts folder.

**Image Crop (LCImageCrop)**  
- Inline crop tool  
- X / Y / Width / Height or free mode  
💡 Crop after all effects so you don’t lose edge treatments (vignette, bloom, etc.).

**Text Overlay (LCTextOverlay)**  
- Adds text on the final image  
- Font, size, color, position, opacity  
💡 Great for watermarks or quick titles.

---

## 使用说明

# 🛑🚫✋ 强烈建议你先固定 seed，跑完图片，然后不要再动之前的任何设置，以免重新处理。

### 节点顺序（按链条从上到下）

**智能降噪 (LCImageDenoise)**  
- 在尽量保留细节的同时去除噪点  
- Sigma：数值高更平滑，低则保留更多细节  
- Threshold：控制降噪强度  
- Radius Multiplier：噪点多的图用高值，干净的图用低值  
💡 从低数值开始。只有真正很噪的时候才提高。

**颜色匹配 (LCColorMatch)**  
- 让当前图匹配参考图（通常是 Image 2）的色调  
- 方法：adain 最常用也最稳定  
- 强度：0–1  
💡 做系列图统一肤色或情绪时很好用。不需要时把参考关掉。

**光晕 (LCBloom)**  
- 给高光加柔和辉光，模拟相机过曝  
- 强度、阈值、大小  
💡 少用一点很梦幻，多用就变雾了。

**暗角 (LCVignette)**  
- 压暗（或提亮）边缘  
- 强度、柔和度、圆度  
💡 柔和暗角比硬黑边自然得多。

**RGB 调整 (LCImageRGB)**  
- 简单的红 / 绿 / 蓝通道增益  


**Lift / Gamma / Gain (LCLiftGammaGain)**  
- 经典三点校色  
- Lift = 阴影  
- Gamma = 中间调  
- Gain = 高光  
💡 大部分“胶片感”颜色工作都在这里完成。

**自动白平衡 (LCAutoWhiteBalance)**  
- 尝试中和整体色偏  
- 方法：“Shades of Gray” 通常最稳妥  
💡 效果比较细微，记得对比前后。

**自然饱和度 (LCVibrance)**  
- 提升不饱和颜色，对已经很艳的颜色和肤色更友好  
- 自然饱和度 + 饱和度 + 强度  
💡 人像优先用这个，而不是普通饱和度。

**色差 (LCChromaticAberration)**  
- 错开 RGB 通道，做出 3D / 复古镜头感  
- 可分别调整红、绿、蓝的水平和垂直偏移  
💡 一点就够。可以试小相反数值（R +2，G –1，B –3）。

**清晰度 (LCClarity)**  
- 自适应中间调对比度 / 微对比  
- 半径、强度、混合模式、阴影/高光控制  
💡 超级重要的节点。用来增加“通透感”但避免纸板剪影效果。

**图像调整 (LCImageAdjust)**  
- 亮度、对比度、饱和度、锐度、模糊  
- 亮度中心 = 0  
- 对比度与饱和度中心 = 1  


**镜头特效 (LCLensFX)**  
- 通用镜头畸变和光学效果  
💡 和下一个节点一起用，模拟更真实的相机光学。

**镜头配置文件 (LCLensProfile)**  
- 应用真实镜头特性（例如 Canon 50mm f/1.8）  
- 可选色差  
💡 给 AI 图加一点真实光学瑕疵，照片感会强很多。

**黑白胶片 (LCFilmStockBW)**  
- 用真实胶片光谱响应转黑白  
- 50+ 种胶片（Ilford HP5+、Kodak Tri-X、Fuji Acros 等）  
- 强度 + 可选滤镜  
💡 想留彩色就关掉这个。

**彩色胶片 (LCFilmStockColor)**  
- 应用经典彩色胶片响应（Ektachrome、Portra 等）  
- 强度是主要控制  
💡 0.6–0.9 往往比满强度更自然。

**胶片颗粒 (LCFilmGrain)**  
- 可精细控制的真实胶片颗粒  
- 强度、缩放、阴影/高光、种子  
💡 固定种子可以让颗粒保持一致。阴影区域颗粒稍强通常更好看。

**去饱和 (LCImageDesaturate)**  
- 部分或完全去饱和  
- 多种方法可选（luminance Rec.709 较常用）  
💡 在套 LUT 之前用，可以做出更柔和的基础色。

**应用 LUT (LCApplyLUT)**  
- 套用 3D LUT（.cube 文件）  
- 强度 0–1  
- Log 选项（部分 LUT 需要）  
💡 免费 LUT 可在 freshluts.com 获取。强度 0.3–0.7 通常比 1.0 好看。把 .cube 文件放进 luts 文件夹。

**裁剪 (LCImageCrop)**  
- 内联裁剪工具  
- X / Y / 宽 / 高 或 free 模式  
💡 所有效果做完再裁，才不会丢掉边缘处理（暗角、光晕等）。

**文字叠加 (LCTextOverlay)**  
- 在最终图上加文字  
- 字体、大小、颜色、位置、透明度  
💡 适合加水印或简单标题。
